A 2:1 movie frame composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop (nothing important at the top or bottom edge). WAIST-UP GROUP SHOT of three, faces large, staggered in depth. DRAW IT EXACTLY IN THE STYLE OF THE ATTACHED CHARACTER SHEET: the same clean confident black ink linework, the same manhwa face design (eye shape, brows, nose, jaw, hairline and hair). It must read as an INKED DRAWING: visible line strokes everywhere — bold tapered contour lines around every figure, drawn fold lines in the silk and armour, hair drawn as inked strands, a little cross-hatching and line shading in the shadows — then flat cel-shading in two or three tones per colour, no airbrushed gradients. Each face must be recognisably the character drawn on the sheet, wearing the same clothes. NOT realistic, NOT an oil painting, NOT photoreal, NOT painterly, NOT a 3D render, no skin pores or photographic texture. ONLY THESE THREE PEOPLE in the frame. THE THREE GODDESS SISTERS OF THE STEAM CAVERN, waist-deep in black water, in their house silk (white jeogori, chima in each one's colour), wet hair, their hair ornaments as on the sheet. Narim, the eldest, centre and a step back, composed and watchful, lit from below by green leaf-light (#3d9e52); Golhwa, the youngest, on the left, leaning forward toward the camera with a wicked, confident grin, a hard ember-orange key (#e86820) raking her face; Hyullé, the quiet one, on the right, half turned away, eyes lowered, knees together, a shy small smile, cyan water-light (#2eb8c4) rippling across her cheek. Steam drifting through the black, a few ember motes and floating leaves. Ordinary living eyes, nothing glowing. LIGHT AND BACKGROUND (deep manhwa tenebrism, darker than a normal splash page): about TWO-THIRDS OF THE FRAME IS PURE INK-BLACK. No set, no architecture or floor beyond what the scene names, no props beyond what the characters hold. Each figure is pulled out of the black by ONE hard, narrow key light from the side or from below in THAT PERSON'S OWN COLOUR, catching only a cheekbone, an eye, the bridge of the nose, the edge of a sleeve, a plate of armour or a hand; the rest of each figure falls off into solid black shadow and merges with the background, so neighbouring figures are separated only by their coloured edge light. SPLIT LIGHTING ON EVERY FIGURE: the lit side of each face and body in that person's colour, the other half PURE BLACK; no even front light, no fill light, no evenly lit robes — even white silk falls to black on its shadow side. Faces readable but half in shadow, eyes catching the light (ordinary eyes — no light streaks or glow across the eyes). At most a few thin wisps of smoke tinted by those coloured lights. Deep inky blacks, crisp highlights, hard cast shadows. Each person's colour is the colour of the light on them — never a glow aura, halo or outline glow. BLOCKING, BODY LANGUAGE AND FACIAL EXPRESSIONS show who they are to each other at a glance. Faces and clothes from the sheet; new poses, never the sheet's stance. One of each person, never cloned. No text, no lettering, no speech bubbles, no panel borders, no watermark.
